_comment: Technique 4, non-deterministic form: neutralising an intent by redefining its id with a
keyword set no player message can ever reach. 'chitchat.season' is declared by
data/mcaconversations/chat_intents/chitchat.json; whichever file the loader reads LAST wins,
and that order is HashMap order, not pack order. See the README - the deterministic form is
the same-path replacement shipped alongside this file.
The parser requires at least one keyword or phrase, and every keyword weight must be in
(0, 10]. So the intent cannot be emptied - it can only be made unreachable. 'requiresAll'
demands every listed token be present, and these two sentinels are not words.
